description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' for managing logging operations in an Android application. It includes constants for log levels, static methods for logging messages at different levels, and methods to set and retrieve the logging target 'LogNode'. It acts as a utility wrapper around Android's native Log utility, enabling chaining and customization of logging behavior.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for logging at various levels and managing LogNode chain.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, with overload for including a Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, with overload for including a Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, with overload for including a Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with overloads for including a Throwable or just a message.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, with overload for including a Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, with overloads for including a Throwable or just a message.
